annotations.title: Buy paid placement for a directory listing (paid, x402)

description: PAID: promote a directory listing you own above free rows for the plan term; paying again extends. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply. Price: from $0.0667 USDC.

dryRun.description: Optional. true: a dry run -- nothing is sent or changed, and the 200 answer (served:true, dryRun:true) says what this call would do with the rest of your body, or which fields are missing. A dry run is a paid call at this price. false or absent: the call runs.

duration.description: Which placement plan to buy; it sets both the placement window and the price. See GET /pricing or the service_card tool for the live table.

id.description: The listing to promote. It must already exist and be owned by the paying wallet -- create it free with POST /listings.
